# Fueling Employees' Initiative: A Meta-Analysis of the Motivational Antecedents of Proactive Work Behavior

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Shan Xu, Jiale Jia, Yumei Wang  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Journal of Organizational Behavior  
**DOI:** [10.1002/job.70018](https://doi.org/10.1002/job.70018)

**Keywords:** proactive work behavior, motivation, meta-analysis, employee initiative, self-efficacy, role breadth

## Abstract

Drawing on Parker et al.'s Proactive Motivation Process Framework, this paper proposes and meta-analytically tests the motivational antecedents of proactive work behavior, identifying key drivers including role breadth self-efficacy, autonomous motivation, and proactive personality.
